issues.explanation: updating hook allows only status/called_at/called_by_user_id but Eloquent also dirties updated_at, so call() always throws LogicException and tickets can never be called.
call() throws Illuminate\Exceptions\AuthorizationException instead of the contracted Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException, breaking callers and the test expectation.
Both models import Attributes\HasFactory instead of the Factories\HasFactory trait, so Queue::factory()/Ticket::factory() are broken.
definition() computes code from a different newly-created queue and forQueue() evaluates nextCode eagerly, so two forQueue tickets get the same code and collide instead of A001/A002.
No retry loop on unique (queue_id,code) violation; DB::transaction(...,3) only retries deadlocks, so concurrent issuance can fail.
nextCode() returns max numeric value instead of last valid code by insertion order required by the task.
Queue has no $casts for is_active boolean and labels_i18n array required by the contract.
Direct creation with negative priority throws LogicException instead of the contracted InvalidArgumentException.
Schema docs add tickets (and duplicate totems) but never document the new queues table.
Missing tests for stale-queue rejection, collision retry, deletion no-reuse, malformed A-X codes, negative priority, and A1000 growth.
Unused imports and trailing ?> closing tag deviate from sibling style.
Unused HasGuarded, HasOne, and RuntimeException imports are dead code.

review.summary: Issuance happy path, queue locking, migrations, and basic call/immutability tests are present, but call() can never succeed due to updated_at being forbidden, factories are broken by the wrong HasFactory import and eager code allocation, the authorization exception type is wrong, and retry plus insertion-order code semantics are missing. Needs substantial rework before merging.
